tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) fear, reverence, terror
1a) fear, terror
1b) reverence
1c) object of reverence
1d) awe-inspiring spectacle or deed
Also means: mo.rah (מוֹרָה "fear" H4172B)

appoint terror (i.e. some awe-inspiring exhibition of power)
Another spelling of mo.ra (מוֹרָא "fear" H4172A)
